note: Curated items; summaries are SoCHarness paraphrases. ATLAS releases and case studies are added from the pinned ATLAS data.

items.title: NYDFS guidance on frontier AI cybersecurity risks
items.summary: Two coordinated documents: frontier AI amplifies the speed and scale of finding and exploiting vulnerabilities; regulated entities should accelerate remediation, review AI-generated code, map third-party dependencies and test resilience more often.

items.title: Agent Control Standard v0.1 and OWASP GenAI updates
items.summary: A runtime governance draft with guardian-agent enforcement points, OpenTelemetry and OCSF observability, and an agent bill of materials.

items.title: New agentic techniques contributed to MITRE ATLAS
items.summary: Tool credential harvesting, tool data poisoning, agent clickbait and data destruction through tool invocation were added to ATLAS.

items.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026)
items.summary: Ten agent-specific risk categories, ASI01 to ASI10, from goal hijack to rogue agents.

items.title: FinCEN alert on deepfake media fraud schemes
items.summary: Red flags for generated identity documents and impersonation used against financial institutions.

items.title: NYDFS industry letter on cybersecurity risks arising from AI
items.summary: AI-enabled social engineering, AI-enhanced attacks, exposure of nonpublic data used by AI, and third-party AI dependencies.

items.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025 edition)
items.summary: The current official LLM list, LLM01 Prompt Injection to LLM10 Unbounded Consumption.
